Criticality.description: Asset criticality context for risk scoring (spec 8, factor A).

DataClassification.description: Data classification context; sensitive/regulated adds +0.10 to factor A, clamped at 1.30 (spec 8).

FailOn.description: Gate threshold: a risk score number or a severity name (spec 4.2).

oneOf.description: Minimum risk score that fails the gate.
Minimum severity that fails the gate.

LayerScanConfig.description: Per-layer overrides ([scan.<layer>] sections, ADR 0004). A layer's exclude list extends the global [scan] exclude for that layer's engines only.

exclude.description: Additional glob patterns excluded for this layer only. Matched against the root-relative POSIX path; a pattern matching a directory path prunes the walk beneath it.

SecretsScanConfig.description: [scan.secrets] overrides (ADR 0004, ADR 0005, ADR 0006): the per-layer exclude, entropy-noise control, and git-history opt-in.

exclude.description: Additional glob patterns excluded for the secrets layer only. Matched against the root-relative POSIX path; a pattern matching a directory path prunes the walk beneath it.

entropy_exclude.description: Globs where the high-entropy fallback is silenced; precise provider rules still run there. Extends the built-in known-noise list (lockfiles, IDE metadata, minified assets — ADR 0005).

history.description: Also scan git-history blobs (ADR 0006): committed-then-removed secrets are still live. Opt-in; requires the git CLI; bounded by hard blob/size caps; degrades to Partial when the root is not a git repository.

exclude.description: Glob patterns to exclude, all layers. Matched against the root-relative POSIX path; a pattern matching a directory path prunes the walk beneath it. Committable, machine-independent (CLI-007).

fail_on.description: Exit 1 if any Finding meets this threshold.

baseline.description: Relative path to a baseline Finding set for delta gating.

ignore_unfixable.description: Gate only on Findings with a fix available.

iac_pack.description: Pinned IaC policy pack, e.g. cis-bundle@1.9.0.

SuppressEntry.description: One [[suppress]] entry. justification, approver, and expires are all mandatory — permanent suppression does not exist (CLI-006). At least one selector (finding_id, rule_id, or path) must be present; when several are, they must all match (ADR 0008).

finding_id.description: Exact Finding to suppress (full id). Selector.

rule_id.description: Suppress Findings whose engine rule/policy/template id equals this (e.g. `high-entropy-string`). Selector; combine with `path` to scope it (ADR 0008).

path.description: Glob over the Finding's root-relative POSIX location path (e.g. `uv.lock`, `vendor/**`). Selector (ADR 0008).

expires.description: Expiry date, RFC 3339 date; after this the Finding gates normally (FR-014).

Config.description: multiscan.toml — committable, diff-friendly, no machine-specific values (CLI-007). Flags override file values; file values override defaults.
